description: agridat is Kevin Wright's R data package collecting documented agricultural experiments from books, papers and public websites. It includes small-plot trials, multi-environment trials, uniformity trials and yield-monitor observations, with dataset-level references and analysis examples. Entries contain measurements such as yields, treatment factors, plot positions and environmental covariates. Geographic and temporal coverage vary by experiment; examples include Norwegian barley measurements and maize trials across multiple locations. The package is publicly available from GitHub and CRAN under MIT, as stated in its DESCRIPTION and licence file. A limitation is that these selected experiments do not form a representative global production survey, and original source citations and variable definitions must be checked before combining tables. The collection can calibrate agricultural response functions or test statistical components of food-supply simulations, complementing the operational yield benchmark CY-Bench (data-cy-bench-subnational-crop-yield-benchmark). Its reference index documents each dataset separately. No experiment tables or R package archive were downloaded.
